title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-30
lineage: AUD > MR > D > PCM > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A surprisingly clear 1968 audience tape captures a hot 3/30/68 set highlighted by a smoking Dark Star, The Other One and rare Born Cross‑Eyed moments.
ai_review.review: Despite being an AUD source, the recording is remarkably clear for a 1968 audience tape, with only occasional mud and a brief source‑switch that most listeners overlook. Musically the show is high‑energy, featuring standout performances of Dark Star, The Other One, Spanish Jam, China Cat > Eleven and the rare Born Cross‑Eyed/Spanish Jam combo, though the second half of Lovelight loses steam for some fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the performance and the surprisingly good audio; the show is energetic with several rare jams, while the recording quality is consistently described as very good for its era.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and detailed for a 1968 AUD tape; occasional murkiness and a source switch around 2:34, plus muted Pigpen keyboards noted by one reviewer.

poor_songs: Lovelight (second half runs out of steam for some listeners)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Rare song pairings and transitions (e.g., Born Cross‑Eyed into Spanish Jam) give the set a historic feel; a few transitions are noted as less smooth, but overall pacing is strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for dynamic soloing style distinct from ’66, engaging banter, and leading audience participation (democratic song‑choice scheme).
band_member_comments.Bob: Keyboard muted in the mix (a noted drawback); his vocal mumbling referenced in later tracks.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ/keyboard presence is reduced due to muting; otherwise no specific comments on other keyboardists.
